[NDBG.14r.2.1] At `ds/loadRecording` time the adapter builds a
**reverse index** in one forward pass over the event stream. The index
is a sorted array per event category (rule fires, fact asserts, fact
retracts, timer fires, etc.), keyed by stream position. Build cost
is O(N) in event count; each subsequent reverse-navigation operation
is O(log N) via binary search. In a live session the adapter extends the
index as it records the run.
